problem_statement: technext/CloudAgency (rebranded here as the one-page marketing site for the brand & packaging design studio 'Halyard & Co.') is a static Bootstrap agency site served directly as HTML/CSS/JS, plus a second real page single_blog.html. Its Portfolio section hosts the studio's work-showcase filter: a row of category chips (All / Web / App / Design / SEO) above six portfolio cards, with a live readout 'Showing N of 6 · <Category>' and an isotope grid that filters the cards when a chip is clicked. A recent change to the filter broke it in three linked ways: (1) on a 390px phone the chip row is pinned to a fixed non-wrapping width so the whole page scrolls sideways; (2) the card grid was refactored into a single non-wrapping strip with a negative left margin so the cards physically overlap, shingle, and run off the right edge, and (3) the shared 'Selected work' folio rail that used to appear on the blog page (single_blog.html) so a reader could jump back into a filtered work view is now missing there. Repair the work-showcase filter so the chip row wraps and stays inside a 390px viewport (no horizontal overflow), the card grid lays out cleanly (no overlap/clipping) on every viewport, clicking a category chip actually filters the grid and updates the 'Showing N of 6 · <Category>' readout live, and the shared folio rail is restored on the blog page — while leaving all copy, section content, DOM structure, and the rest of the Bootstrap theme unchanged.
required_content: The Portfolio section shows the work-showcase filter: five category chips (All / Web / App / Design / SEO), a 'Showing N of 6 · <Category>' readout, and six portfolio cards.
Clicking the 'Web' chip filters the grid to the two web cards and updates the readout to 'Showing 2 of 6 · Web'; clicking a category always keeps the readout in sync with the shown cards.

On a 390px mobile viewport the page has no horizontal overflow beyond a small tolerance: the chip row wraps and the card grid reflows to fit the screen instead of forcing the document wider than the viewport.
The card grid lays out cleanly with no overlapping, shingled, or clipped cards on mobile (390px), tablet (834px), and desktop (1440px).
The shared 'Selected work' folio rail appears on both the Portfolio surface and the blog page single_blog.html so a reader can jump back into a filtered work view from either surface.

The navbar, masthead, About, Services, Portfolio, Testimonials, Pricing, Blog, Contact form, and footer remain present and unchanged in content and structure; no new console errors or failed network requests are introduced.
design_constraints: Preserve the CloudAgency Bootstrap design language: red accent, uppercase headings, full-bleed parallax masthead, section rhythm, and section order.

Fix ONLY the work-showcase-filter defect (chip-row layout, card-grid layout, filter/readout wiring, and the shared folio rail's cross-page presence); do not rewrite copy, restructure sections, add or remove portfolio images, or change the navigation.

The filter repair must live in the folio component's own stylesheet (assets/css/folio.css) and script (assets/js/folio.js) and the shared rail markup, and must not depend on hiding overflow at the body/html level or clipping cards off-screen.
The filter must fit 390px mobile, 834px tablet, and 1440px desktop viewports; all chips and cards stay readable and non-overlapping at every size.
Keep the site self-contained and offline-clean: no remote fonts, maps, or scripts may be reintroduced.
state_constraints: desktop_home and mobile_home capture the site top at 1440px / 390px; with the defect the broken chip row and card strip drag the 390px document sideways, and the repair brings horizontal overflow within tolerance.
tablet_home captures the page at 834px, where the filter must lay out cleanly after the repair.
desktop_portfolio captures the Portfolio section at 1440px before any filter click: the chip row, the 'Showing 6 of 6 · All' readout, and the six cards.
desktop_portfolio_web captures the Portfolio section after clicking the 'Web' chip: the grid filters to two web cards and the readout reads 'Showing 2 of 6 · Web'.
mobile_portfolio captures the Portfolio section at 390px, verifying the chip row wraps and the card grid no longer forces the document to overflow horizontally.
desktop_blog captures single_blog.html at 1440px, verifying the shared 'Selected work' folio rail is present on the blog page.

change_completion: The Portfolio work-showcase filter renders five category chips, a 'Showing N of 6 · <Category>' readout, and six portfolio cards.
Clicking the 'Web' chip filters the grid to two cards and updates the readout to 'Showing 2 of 6 · Web' live.
The shared 'Selected work' folio rail is restored on the blog page single_blog.html.
design_consistency: The repair preserves the CloudAgency Bootstrap identity, section order, and all surrounding content.
The card grid lays out cleanly with no overlapping, shingled, or clipped cards, and the fix does not clip or hide content to mask overflow.
responsive: On a 390px mobile viewport the chip row wraps and the card grid reflows so the document width stays within the viewport (no horizontal overflow).
At 834px tablet and 1440px desktop the filter and card grid stay responsive and lay out cleanly with no horizontal overflow.
regression: Navbar, masthead, About, Services, Portfolio, Testimonials, Pricing, Blog, Contact, and footer remain present and unchanged.
No new console errors or failed network requests appear on any captured state.

author_notes: Repo-grounded repair/experience_continuity/flow task on the static technext/CloudAgency Bootstrap marketing template (rebranded 'Halyard & Co.', served directly, no build). The native lever is the template's own Portfolio work-showcase filter (the isotope category chips it already ships), upgraded with a first-class 'Showing N of 6 · <Category>' readout namespaced folio__ and a shared 'Selected work' folio rail that also appears on the blog page. The seeded defect breaks the filter in four orthogonal ways graded independently: a fixed non-wrapping chip row causes mobile horizontal overflow; the card grid is refactored into a shingled overlapping strip (a credible broken layout, not a recolor); the folio rail is dropped from the blog page (cross-page presence regression); and on the bad solution the filter readout is frozen to a stale 'Showing 6 of 6 · All' snapshot so the click registers but the terminal state never updates. Reference/baseline/bad differ only in index.html (portfolio markup), single_blog.html (rail presence), assets/css/folio.css, and assets/js/folio.js; the surrounding Bootstrap theme, imagery, and copy are identical. Design keywords: portfolio filter, category chips, result readout, isotope grid, responsive wrap, cross-page rail. Assets: portfolio1..6.jpg cards, main_logo.png wordmark.
